_comment: Portrait single-card template — see docs/card-structure-schema.md. GEOMETRY DOES NOT LIVE HERE. For a card_structure:'cards' theme the four shared word slots and the eight per-front title positions are `card_slots` on the themes.json entry, written by the admin calibrator; grapefruit's is still null (uncalibrated), which is why the entry is visibility:private + calibrated:false.
